{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for thousands separators
print("Unique values in revenue (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:", has_commas.sum())

# Preview the first few rows after casting
print("\nFirst 5 rows after converting revenue to float:")
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
print(df[['revenue', 'revenue_float']].head())"}
